title: Samoa Joe vs. Kurt Angle
summary: TNA’s unbeaten destroyer meets the Olympic gold medalist. Their first trilogy tests Joe’s aura before the rivalry reaches a world-title cage match.

chapters.title: Angle ends Joe’s unbeaten streak
chapters.result: Kurt Angle defeats Samoa Joe by submission.
chapters.context: Joe’s long run without being pinned or submitted in TNA ends in Angle’s first TNA pay-per-view match.

chapters.title: Joe forces Angle to submit
chapters.context: Joe answers the loss with a submission victory of his own, forcing a deciding encounter.

chapters.title: Angle wins the Iron Man decider
chapters.result: Angle defeats Joe three falls to two in a 30-minute Iron Man match.
chapters.context: The first trilogy ends with Angle ahead, but Joe’s quest to overtake him continues.

chapters.title: Joe captures the world championship
chapters.result: Joe defeats Angle in a cage to win the TNA world title.
chapters.context: With his career at stake under the match stipulation, Joe finally converts the rivalry into his first TNA world championship.
